data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for RudderStack event tracking and analytics
data.what_it_does: Provides native event tracking for Android, iOS and web, integrating with RudderStack’s data plane. It supports custom contexts, device tokens, anonymous IDs and advertising IDs.
use_when: You need enterprise‑grade analytics with data residency control
You want to send events to multiple destinations via RudderStack
You need native push notification integration via device tokens
avoid_when: You only need a simple analytics solution without native plugins
You are already using another analytics SDK that covers your needs
strengths: Native platform plugins for Android, iOS and web
Supports custom contexts, device tokens, anonymous IDs and advertising IDs
weaknesses: Requires platform‑specific setup for each plugin
data.setup_notes: Add rudder_sdk_flutter to pubspec, run flutter pub get, import RudderClient and initialize with write key and URLs. No build_runner needed.
